description:
20*50/20*60 Wall Anti-collision Decorative Soft Bag Bedside Cushion Soft Backdrop Children's Room Wall Self Adhesive
Material: Sponge + Leather
Bottom Board: MDF Eco-friendly fiberboard

Size: (Approximately)
Width 20 x Length 50 x Thickness 3.5 CM
Width 20 x Length 60 x Thickness 3.5 CM

Product Features:
⦿ Easy to clean.
⦿ Waterproof.
⦿ Fast and convenient.
⦿ High quality material.
⦿ Safe and formaldehyde-free.
⦿ High-elastic sponge to protect your baby's safety and reliability.
⦿ Tear off the back film and stick the adhesive directly to the wall.
⦿ Can be attached to the bed or wall to prevent collision.
⦿ Can easily change the style of your walls and create a cozy atmosphere in a room like a living room, hallway, or bedroom.

Package Includes:
1 x Wall Cushion Soft Backdrop (Others Not Included)

Friendly Reminder:
This product is suitable for flat, clean and dry walls or surfaces. It should be noted that the wall needs to be wiped before installation to make the glue fit more closely. If you want to stick it on a textured painted wall or diatom mud convex wall, it is recommended to use liquid nails or glass glue for reinforcement.

Notices:
-The color might be a little bit different due to different screen displays.
-All pictures & videos shown are for purpose illustration only.
